triples.evidence_text: Each piping system, or part of a system, which may be exposed to a pressure greater than that for which it is designed, is to be protected from over pressurization by a relief valve.
is to be protected from over pressurization by a relief valve

triples.head_surface: systems are served only by centrifugal pumps such that the pressure delivered by the pump cannot exceed the design pressure of the piping
triples.head_canonical_zh: 仅由离心泵供液且泵出口压力不超过管路设计压力的系统
triples.evidence_text: Where systems are served only by centrifugal pumps such that the pressure delivered by the pump cannot exceed the design pressure of the piping, relief valves are not necessary.

triples.head_surface: thermometers or other temperature sensing devices
triples.head_canonical_zh: 温度计或其他温度传感装置
triples.evidence_text: Where thermometers or other temperature sensing devices are fitted in piping systems, thermometer wells are to be used so that the devices can be removed without impairing the integrity of the pressurized system.

triples.head_surface: pressure gauges or other pressure sensing devices
triples.head_canonical_zh: 压力表或其他压力传感装置
triples.evidence_text: Where pressure gauges or other pressure sensing devices are fitted in piping systems, valves are to be provided so that the devices can be isolated and removed without impairing the integrity of the pressurized system.

triples.head_surface: Pressure, temperature and level sensing devices installed on tanks
triples.head_canonical_zh: 安装在液舱上的压力、温度和液位传感装置
triples.tail_surface: fitted with valves or arranged such that they may be removed without emptying the tank
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 装设阀门或布置成可在不排空液舱的情况下拆卸
triples.evidence_text: Pressure, temperature and level sensing devices installed on tanks at locations where they are subjected to a static head of liquid are to be fitted with valves or arranged such that they may be removed without emptying the tank.

triples.head_surface: failure of the material in the event of a fire
triples.evidence_text: failure of the material in the event of a fire would give rise to danger of flooding

triples.head_surface: Materials readily rendered ineffective by heat
triples.tail_surface: not to be used for connection to the shell
triples.evidence_text: Materials readily rendered ineffective by heat are not to be used for connection to the shell where the failure of the material in the event of a fire would give rise to danger of flooding.
